target_customer: Oncology patients with late stage solid tumors, via future clinical partners and biopharma
problem: Dendritic cells are often dysfunctional in cancer patients and limit other immunotherapies. The company aimed to make patient specific therapeutic dendritic cells from stem cells to restore anti-tumor immunity.
business_model: Therapeutics development, pre-revenue, aiming at clinical milestones and partnerships

founders.name: Ananya Zutshi
prior_employers: Pharma and biotech manufacturing and development operations roles (employers not named on YC page)
education: Harvard, master's in Engineering Sciences and MBA
founders.background_notes: Blavatnik Fellow at Harvard Business School and Kaplan Fellow per YC page.

founders.name: Ricky Barrett
prior_employers: University of Pennsylvania (postdoctoral fellow, tumor immunity and cell therapy)
Florida Atlantic University (marine biologist and scientific diver)
education: University of Central Florida, PhD Biomedical Sciences (Immunology)
founders.background_notes: Co-founded the Philadelphia chapter of Nucleate. Science communicator with a large TikTok and Instagram audience.

competitors.name: OxVax
competitors.what: UK developer of a next generation dendritic cell vaccine platform for solid tumors
competitors.funding_then: about 12.5M seed in April 2021 per a database entry (unverified)

competitors.name: PDC*line Pharma
competitors.what: Plasmacytoid dendritic cell line based cancer vaccine platform

technical_complexity.rationale: Reprogramming patient stem cells into therapeutic dendritic cells needs cell manufacturing, GMP and clinical validation, far beyond a small team without lab capital.

defensibility.rationale: Cell differentiation know-how and IP could be defensible, but at founding there was no clinical data and the team was two people.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found; the company itself reported hibernation in late 2024 per a directory listing.

market_need_then: Cell therapies for solid tumors remained an unmet need in 2022, and dendritic cell dysfunction is described by the company as a bottleneck for other immunotherapies.

branding.domain_note: Uses guardian-bio.com, a hyphenated domain; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Science forward, patient focused launch copy (Control Immunity with Dendritic Cells)

branding.community_and_virality: Co-founder Barrett runs a science communication audience of over 250,000 on TikTok and Instagram per YC page; no evidence it was tied to the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several unrelated Guardian companies and no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Guardian Bio was a two founder dendritic cell therapy startup in YC Summer 2022 that raised a small pre-seed with Brazen Capital and other backers and went through Creative Destruction Lab. A 2024 BIO listing said it was seeking a 3M seed round, and a directory says the founders put it into hibernation in November 2024, which suggests it could not raise the capital that cell therapy development needs. This is based on a single third party note and the cause is not public.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 503 when fetched. Aggregators (StartupHub, Persana) report about 500K pre-seed; CB Insights lists CDL, YC and Realm Capital Ventures instead; unverified so not recorded as an amount. Hibernation claim from a single directory, unverified. Status in YC directory is Active. A third party profile lists Karolina Palucka as co-founder; not on the YC page so not listed.
